svg.aria-label: Three bar panels by agent version on the same 54 questions, one trial each. Tokens billed per run, in millions: v0 18.4, v1 10.2, v2 9.6, v3 11.9, v4 7.0, v5 2.4, v6 2.4, v7 2.3, v8 2.4. Wall time per trial at the 95th percentile, in seconds: v0 911, v1 177, v2 152, v3 237, v4 215, v5 53, v6 44, v7 58, v8 57. Cost per run in US dollars: v0 8.96, v1 4.60, v2 4.51, v3 5.20, v4 6.59, v5 5.04, v6 5.12, v7 5.15, v8 5.36. The champions are filled; the SQL rebuild and the switch to Opus made the agent short.
svg.title: Tokens per run fell 7.6 times and p95 wall 16 times, v0 to v8, for 40 percent less per run
